gist: Practical notes on glazes, clay behaviour and throwing pots, plus a sense of the hobby's return. First evening back at Lena's wheel on 18 May felt like breathing again [n21]. Six bowls thrown on 21 Jun, two survived trimming [n37]. Glaze notes from 25 Jun: tenmoku breaks rust-brown on edges and needs thick application; shino crawls if applied over dust, so wipe bisque first; speckled oatmeal is Lena's recipe and works best at cone 6 [n124]. Clay Times newsletters on reclaiming scraps and mixing glazes safely arrived in May and July [n137, n180]. No open tasks or upcoming dates. Current state is unchanged since late June. Nothing suspicious. The glaze notes link to the pottery venture topic only loosely.
